text: The redesign mockup canvas (docs/v7/mockups-2026-10-03/) is the confirmed visual reference for slices 2a to 2e: Shelf home, Bible reader and lesson (desktop and phone), the docked Theologian (desktop) and centered Theologian (phone), Learning Path (path, module and unit on one page), Study Topics, and Review & Practice. Built pages follow these layouts in the Reading Room theme; other themes restyle the same layouts.
